meaning_first.independence_note: Fresh reviewer context, separate from the author. The blind packet of the original (hash 90be0d9c34dd8c671fdcc8adbed85293d5adeb37fda686f417b9986f4cc10a79) was read first and item findings were written to content/reviews/102-review.md before the questions, notes or plan were opened. After the repairs the packet was rebuilt from the exact proposed bytes and the meaning pass repeated for the five changed items; the hash recorded here is that final packet.

tone_balance.scope_note: One of six items is lightly funny (pauze-werk, the free but bad coffee); the small-batch rounded cap is ceil(6 x 0.15) = 1. The coordinator checks the combined A1 count across batches.

edits.before: Dat kost twintig euro. U kunt met uw pinpas betalen.
edits.after: Dat kost twintig euro. U betaalt dan bij ons.
edits.reason: "pinpas" is a compound a first-weeks learner will not know and the payment sentence tests nothing; plain words keep the real salon detail and the turn stays natural.

edits.before: Aylin: Dat is goed. Is er veel kapot? / De verkoper: Nee. De fiets heeft nu een nieuwe lamp. / Het kost vijftien euro. Dat is niet duur.
edits.after: Aylin: Dat is goed. Wat doet u met de fiets? / De verkoper: De fiets krijgt een nieuwe lamp. De oude lamp is kapot. / Dat kost vijftien euro.
edits.reason: The original said the bike was not ready yet but then spoke as if the work was done ("heeft nu", "Nee" to a question she could not ask about work not yet finished), and the seller praised his own price. Now the repair is consistent with the day it is ready and the price follows from it.

edits.before: Wat is nieuw? / De fiets heeft nu een nieuwe lamp.
edits.after: Wat krijgt de fiets? / De fiets krijgt een nieuwe lamp.
edits.reason: Follows the repaired turn; the options stay A/B/C with the same key.

edits.before: Het kost vijftien euro. Dat is niet duur.
Waar gaat de klas naartoe? / Naar het park. / Naar het strand. / Naar het bos.
edits.after: Waar is de klas vrijdag? / In het park. / Op het strand. / In het bos.
edits.reason: "naartoe" is a function word beginners meet late and the prompt could be read as the route; the plain location question tests the same fact and the key stays C.

edits.before: Ik werk in het ziekenhuis. Het werk is druk. / Mooi! Heb je ook kinderen? / Ja, twee. Kom je zondag koffie drinken?
edits.after: Ik werk in het ziekenhuis. Ik werk veel. / Mooi! Dan ben je niet vaak thuis. / Ja, maar zondag ben ik thuis. Kom je koffie drinken?
edits.reason: The question about children came from nowhere ("ook" with no earlier mention) and the invitation did not follow from it. Now work leads to being away from home, which leads to Sunday and the invitation. "druk" is also replaced by "veel".

edits.before: Kom je zondag koffie drinken? / Saar vraagt: kom je zondag koffie drinken?
edits.after: Ja, maar zondag ben ik thuis. / Saar zegt: zondag ben ik thuis.

edits.before: En de koffie? / De koffie is gratis, maar niet lekker. / Leuk! Tot hoe laat werken we vrijdag?
edits.after: Moet ik koffie kopen? / Nee, de koffie is gratis, maar niet lekker. / Oké. Tot hoe laat werken we vrijdag?
edits.reason: "En de koffie?" is elliptical (what about it?) and "Leuk!" is a strange reaction to the joke. The new question gives the gratis answer a real reason and keeps the one light joke.
Matches Timo's own question and the word in the situation; "eten" in the answer still has to be understood.

edits.before: Ik breng een grote taart mee. Ik maak hem zelf.
edits.after: Ik neem een grote taart mee. Ik maak hem zelf.
edits.reason: "meebrengen" is a separable verb that is not on the word list; "meenemen" is.
The source never says Nora and Mert are siblings, so "Hun moeder" assumed an off-page relationship; "Oma" is anchored (oma wordt blij) and clearly false.

edits.before: Ik werk in het ziekenhuis. Het werk is druk.

edits.reason: Follows the repaired turn (verbatim, lower case after "Nee,").

Mert's traits are identical in both briefs (short curly dark hair, olive green jacket). Alts are neutral and reveal no key.

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
The word gate is list-based; whether "afspraak", "ziekenhuis" or "bos" is known in the first weeks is an editorial judgment.
Natural-sounding speech and pace need a listening check after the audio is generated.

meaning.situation_summary: Mert phones the hairdresser to book a haircut for his son. Saturday is full, so he takes Friday at four, hears the price and says goodbye.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Book a slot and learn the price before going; the call ends with a fixed day, hour and cost.
meaning.contrivance_check: A parent booking for a child by phone is an everyday call; Saturday full then Friday free is the natural reason for the day change and no off-page event is needed. The payment sentence now says only that payment happens at the salon.

turn_links.quote: Hallo, met Mert. Mijn zoon wil graag een afspraak voor zaterdag.
turn_links.response_function: Mert names himself and states the request: an appointment for his son on Saturday.

turn_links.quote: Zaterdag is vol. Vrijdag om vier uur is nog vrij.
turn_links.response_function: She refuses Saturday as full and offers Friday at four, answering the request directly.

turn_links.quote: Vrijdag is goed. Wat kost het voor mijn zoon?
turn_links.response_function: He accepts Friday and asks the price, the next thing a caller wants to know.

turn_links.quote: Dat kost twintig euro. U betaalt dan bij ons.
turn_links.response_function: She gives the price and says where to pay, answering his question.

turn_links.quote: Goed, dank u wel. Tot ziens!
turn_links.response_function: He thanks her and ends the call.
